description: Avoid a duplicate expensive read-only tool call before repeating source-backed validation, especially across an agent fleet. Use for repeated paid web search, metered scraping, browser/extraction, rate-limited APIs, duplicate API validation or multi-step validation when the caller already has a known value. Returns SAME_OBSERVED, CHANGED_OBSERVED, CONTESTED, STALE or UNKNOWN. Only SAME_OBSERVED can be considered for caller-policy-gated reuse; every other status requires normal authoritative validation before OBSERVE. SeenRelay never browses or verifies externally.

fact.description: Source-backed fact coordinate whose recent shared evidence should be checked.

locator.description: Stable source-native locator. Prefer this when the source exposes one.

scheme.description: Source-native locator type: RFC 6901-style JSON pointer, stable HTML element id, or stable source-native key.

value.description: Source-native locator value. json_pointer values must begin with /; locator bytes are otherwise preserved.

predicate.description: Stable shared machine identifier; identity-bearing only when locator is absent.

qualifiers.description: Identity-bearing semantic qualifiers. Include only fields needed to distinguish otherwise identical source-backed facts.

source.description: Stable credential-free absolute HTTP(S) source URL. Tracking parameters are removed; authentication or signature query parameters are rejected.

subject.description: Human-readable label; excluded from canonical fact identity.

known_value.description: Caller-known value to compare with recent observations. Mutable observed content is excluded from fact identity.

max_age_seconds.description: Maximum age, in seconds, of shared observations the caller is willing to consider. Omit to use the service default.

name: check_fact

outputSchema.description: CHECK result. Exactly one of a decision status or an error is expected; additional evidence fields may be present.

error.description: Present instead of a decision status when CHECK cannot be admitted or is controlled.

detail.description: Human-readable error detail. A tool error is not evidence that the source value is unchanged.

fact_key.description: Canonical SeenRelay fact identity for this coordinate.

next_step.description: Explicit cold/stale-path instruction: validate the authoritative source normally, then OBSERVE the independently obtained result.

status.description: Decision status when CHECK succeeds. Only SAME_OBSERVED can be considered for reuse, and only under caller policy. CHANGED_OBSERVED, CONTESTED, STALE and UNKNOWN require normal authoritative validation before any OBSERVE.

useful_reuse_awards.description: Qualified reuse awards attributable to this CHECK under SeenRelay telemetry rules; not a truth or independence score.

title: Check Fact Freshness
